summary_en: Sankyu cancelled a previous buyback authorization and initiated a new buyback program to acquire up to 25 million shares for a maximum of 20 billion yen (9.97% of outstanding shares) through market purchase from January 4 to August 31, 2027. Shares acquired will be cancelled in September 2027 to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency, and to mitigate market impact from a concurrent equity offering.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Share Acquisition, Decision on New Share Acquisition, and Decision on Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief:
On November 19, 2026, Sankyu's board of directors cancelled a previous share buyback program authorized on May 14, 2026 (which had not been executed) and approved a new buyback authorization to acquire up to 25 million common shares with a maximum aggregate purchase price of 20 billion yen, representing 9.97% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from January 4, 2027 to August 31, 2027.

The company stated two purposes for this buyback: (1) to enhance shareholder returns and maximize corporate value through improved capital efficiency, and (2) to mitigate market impact from a concurrent equity offering announced the same day. No shares were acquired under the previous authorization, as the company suspended purchases during periods when it possessed material undisclosed information to avoid insider trading violations.

Upon completion of the buyback, all treasury shares exceeding 5% of outstanding shares at that time will be cancelled effective September 21, 2027. The specific number of shares to be cancelled will be announced after the acquisition program concludes.
